model.title: To make revisions in title 51, United States Code, as necessary to keep the title current, and to make technical amendments to improve the United States Code.

summary.text: The bill would update and reorganize existing federal laws related to U.S. space programs and commercial space activities by consolidating them into title 51 of the United States Code. It aims to keep space-related statutes current and fix technical issues in the broader legal code.
